caption: The drawing depicts a cross with a gray border that has carved or scalloped details, and four symmetrical, leaf-like extensions at each end. The interior sections of the cross are decorated with an intricate, symmetrical pattern of pastel colors, including shades of light blue, pink, white, and green. The pattern consists of floral and wavy designs, with blue and pink dominating the central vertical and horizontal axes. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or decorations present. The artist's signature, "MAZE G. CAROLIN," is written in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Cross
